description: True-or-false quiz statements with the correct answer, from the community-written and moderator-reviewed Open Trivia Database (CC BY-SA 4.0), by category and difficulty or mixed. Handy for quick rounds, icebreakers and classroom warm-ups. Statements are drawn at random each call; the true/false bank is smaller than the multiple-choice one, so narrow category plus difficulty combinations may have only a handful. (cost: 1 credit)

amount.description: integer, optional, number of statements 1-50, default 10

category.description: string or integer, optional, category id (9-32) or name such as "sports", "animals", "film"; default any category

difficulty.description: string, optional, easy | medium | hard; default a mix

name: trivia_true_false
